title: The taming of the shrew
summary: The Taming of the Shrew is a comedy by William Shakespeare, set in Padua and Petruchio's country house. It opens with an induction in which a drunken tinker, Christopher Sly, is tricked by a lord into believing he is a nobleman, and a troupe of players is invited to perform for him. The main action follows two sisters. Katharina, the elder, has a reputation for a sharp, quarrelsome tongue, which blocks the marriage of her younger sister Bianca, who is courted by several suitors. Lucentio, who disguises himself as a tutor, woos Bianca, while his servant Tranio impersonates him. Petruchio, a gentleman from Verona, agrees to marry the difficult Katharina for her dowry and sets about taming her through a campaign of outrageous behaviour, deprivation and mock-obedience. The play closes with a wager among the husbands over which wife is the most obedient, and with Katharina delivering a speech on wifely duty. The work is known for its sharp wordplay, its farcical disguises, and its debated treatment of gender and marriage.
